title: Hiring 2D Animators for Rano Chidiya Cartoon
content: 🎨 We’re Hiring 2D Animators! 🐦✨ Love animation, cartoon storytelling, and bringing characters to life? Rano Chidiya Cartoon is looking for creative 2D Animators who are skilled in Adobe Animate, Photoshop & Illustrator and understand storytelling. 📩 Apply Now: work.tunistorytv@gmail.com 🎬 Send your portfolio/showreel along with your application. Join us and help bring amazing cartoon stories to life! 🌳🐦✨
